subtitle: Three dinners, planned together. Cook them in order so the fresh food carries from one night to the next.

meals.name: Smoked Garlic-Butter Chicken Thighs
meals.blurb: Low-and-slow thighs basted in garlic butter — an easy first smoker win.
ingredients: 1 tsp garlic powder + ½ tsp paprika
Wood chips or pellets for the smoker

det: 4 tbsp butter, melted
3 cloves garlic, grated
1 tsp garlic powder + ½ tsp paprika
Pinch of salt and pepper
Whisk smooth

prep.t: Pat dry and coat the thighs
det: 4 lb bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs
Pat very dry with paper towel
Brush all over with the garlic butter
Keep half the butter back for basting
Set the smoker to 250°F
Add a small handful of wood chips or pellets
Let it settle at temp before the chicken goes on
Lay thighs skin-up on the grate
Baste once at the 1-hour mark
Pull at 175°F internal (about 2 hours)
Keep the lid closed — resist peeking

cook.t: Prep the potatoes and green beans
det: Scrub 1.5 lb baby potatoes and halve them
Wash and trim 1 lb green beans
Toss both with olive oil, salt, and garlic powder
Spread on a sheet pan — now they’re ready to roast

cook.t: Roast the potatoes and green beans
det: 425°F oven
Roast until the potatoes are tender and the beans blister
Skin-side over direct heat or under the broiler, 3–4 min
Rest 5 min before serving
Serve 4 thighs with potatoes and beans
Shred about 1¼ lb of the rest for tomorrow’s pasta

leftovers: Fridge the shredded chicken up to 4 days.
Remember: ½ lb green beans stays raw for Night 3.

meals.name: Pesto Chicken & Broccoli Angel Hair
meals.blurb: Last night’s smoked chicken tossed with pesto, broccoli, and angel hair.
ingredients: ½ cup grated parmesan, plus more to finish

det: Shred 1¼ lb smoked chicken (from last night) into bite-size pieces
Cut 1 head broccoli into florets
Measure ⅔ cup pesto and grate ½ cup parmesan
Set out 1 cup peas and 2 tbsp butter — now just grab as you go
Big pot, well salted
Bring to a rolling boil
Have the 12 oz angel hair ready
Add pasta to the boiling water
Cook 4–5 min to al dente
Reserve ½ cup pasta water, then drain
Steam the broccoli florets and peas until just tender
Pasta + the pesto + the shredded chicken
Splash of pasta water + the butter
Stir in the parmesan
Set aside ¼ cup garlic-parm butter for Night 3
Top with broccoli, peas, and more parmesan
A crack of black pepper

leftovers: Reheat with a splash of water or milk.

meals.name: Garlic-Butter Smash Burgers
meals.blurb: Crispy-edged smash burgers with roasted green beans and baked beans.
ingredients: ½ lb green beans from Night 1
¼ cup garlic-parm butter from Night 2
Optional: brown-sugar BBQ sauce (check the label)

det: Loosely form 1.5 lb ground beef into 6 balls — don’t pack them (salt just before they hit the pan)
Wash and trim ½ lb green beans, toss with the garlic-parm butter + a little oil on a sheet pan
Open the can of baked beans
Set out the cheddar, buns, and BBQ sauce — now it’s all grab-and-go
425°F until blistered, about 18 min
Shake the pan halfway
1 can baked beans in a small pot
Low heat, stir now and then
Screaming-hot griddle or cast iron
Smash each ball flat, then salt
2–3 min, flip, cheddar on top
Toast brioche buns in the butter
Cheddar burger on a toasted bun
Optional: brown-sugar BBQ sauce — CHECK LABEL for apple/cider
Serve with green beans and baked beans

leftovers: Lunch: burger over green beans, or chopped into a rice bowl.
Reheat the beans with a splash of water.

items.note: Smoke Night 1; shred 1¼ lb for Night 2
1 lb roast Night 1, ½ lb roast Night 3
CHECK LABEL: no apple, apple juice, or cider vinegar
